note: Things the company carries and uses from the menu. Owned counts live in the flags as have.<id>, like fittings. heal is the share of full health given back; who is one person or the whole party travelling. battle: the item is thrown in a fight (its skill in data/battle/skills.json); heal is 0 for those.

bandage.name: Clean bandages
bandage.text: Boiled linen, rolled tight. Binds one person's cuts.

salve.name: Honey salve
salve.text: Thick and golden. Keeps a deep wound clean while it closes.

willowbark.name: Willowbark tea
willowbark.text: Bitter, but it eases every ache. Enough for everyone travelling together.

firepot.name: Fire pot
firepot.text: Lamp oil and pitch in a clay pot, a rag for a wick. Thrown in a fight; the cleverer the hand, the better the throw.

dart.name: Numbing dart
dart.text: Tipped with venom milked from a wadeskin. It numbs whatever it strikes. Thrown in a fight.

snare.name: Snare charge
snare.text: A coiled spring and a hook, set to go off underfoot. Thrown in a fight.
